log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Mirror teams so the Fire-Water-Steel triangle avoids a bad matchup to switch out of. Gholdengo leads immune to Fake Out and ExtremeSpeed and blocks Parting Shot and Taunt.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Summarizing system rules for Pokémon turn selection, including thought length, decision format, and legal actions.Identifying the format and Mega evolution legality from the team preview and item list.Selecting a 3v3 core for the mirror by weighing speed ties, mega stat changes, and type synergy.Evaluating speed tiers and type triangle to pick a lead and 3v3 core.

decisions.thought: Our 106 Speed is slow and likely moves second in this mirror, so we lose a Shadow Ball trade. Incineroar resists both STABs and threatens Flare Blitz, so switch out of the bad matchup.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Summarizing rules for a Pokémon Champions turn decision with thought and action format constraints.Evaluating move legality and fallback for a Pokémon Champions turn with thought and decision formatting.Assessing speed uncertainty and damage tradeoffs for the Gholdengo mirror matchup.Evaluating speed disadvantage and pivot options for the Gholdengo mirror matchup.

decisions.thought: Opposing Gholdengo is at -2 SpA so it can't threaten Incineroar, and Good as Gold blocks Parting Shot and Taunt. Flare Blitz is super effective for a likely knockout.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Fake Out legality for Incineroar given its recent switch-in and turn state.Ruling out status moves due to Good as Gold and focusing on a direct damage option.

decisions.thought: Incineroar is in a bad matchup: Flare Blitz is resisted and it is weak to likely Earthquake while Dragonite outspeeds. Primarina is immune to Dragon and threatens back with Moonblast.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokemon battle state and move legality to choose the best action for Incineroar versus Dragonite.Evaluating Parting Shot for pivot and debuff versus switching to Gholdengo for Steel resistance.Comparing Gholdengo and Primarina switch-ins against Dragonite's coverage and Extreme Speed immunity.Evaluating Parting Shot versus hard switches while weighing Incineroar preservation and Dragonite's coverage.

decisions.thought: Primarina is slower than Dragonite and will likely be knocked out by Earthquake before it can move. Gholdengo is weak to Ground, so it's a bad matchup to switch into. Incineroar takes neutral damage and drops Attack with Intimidate.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing battle state to select the optimal single action based on speed, knockout potential, or matchup for a Pokémon Champions singles turn.Evaluating remaining legal moves and matchup risks before choosing the next action.

decisions.thought: Dragonite outspeeds Incineroar and this is a bad matchup to stay in with Earthquake threatening. Fake Out's +3 priority beats Extreme Speed and should flinch, saving HP before pivoting.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing turn constraints and selecting the single best legal action based on speed, knockout potential, or matchup.Evaluating legal moves against the active opponent while accounting for bench threats and ability uncertainty.Resolving Fake Out priority and Multiscale state to choose between attack and pivot.Evaluating Fake Out flinch chance versus Parting Shot pivot given type matchups and speed priority.

decisions.thought: Incineroar is slower than Dragonite and weak to Earthquake, a bad matchup to stay in. Parting Shot pivots out while dropping its Attack further from -1.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Incineroar’s legal moves against Mega Dragonite while weighing damage, priority, and switching to Primarina or Gholdengo.Assessing Parting Shot to reduce Dragonite's attack and enable a safer switch.Evaluating Parting Shot risk versus a direct switch to Gholdengo given move priority and damage.

decisions.thought: Must pivot after Parting Shot. Primarina at 65 HP risks a knockout from opposing Primarina even at -1. Gholdengo resists Fairy and threatens super-effective Make It Rain.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating the forced switch after Parting Shot to choose between low-HP Primarina and full-HP Gholdengo.Comparing Gholdengo's type advantage against Primarina versus keeping low-HP Primarina in.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo resists Primarina's Fairy STAB and Primarina is at -1 SpA from Parting Shot, so this is a free setup turn. Nasty Plot avoids the Make It Rain drop and sets up a sweep.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Gholdengo versus Primarina matchup and speed uncertainty to choose the optimal move.Assessing type matchups and damage multipliers to confirm Make It Rain as the optimal offensive choice.Reevaluating type matchups to correct damage calculations and weighing Nasty Plot setup against a potential pivot threat.

decisions.thought: Primarina is debuffed and resists nothing here, so a switch to their Gholdengo to resist Make It Rain is likely. Shadow Ball punishes that switch super-effectively without dropping my Sp. Atk.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Gholdengo's type advantage and move options against Primarina while weighing bench matchups and risk.Assessing Primarina's neutral damage versus Gholdengo and the KO potential of a boosted super-effective move.Evaluating Shadow Ball versus Make It Rain against likely switches while accounting for type matchups and stat drops.Comparing Shadow Ball and Make It Rain for KO probability and switch risk while preserving stat boosts.

decisions.thought: +2 STAB super-effective Make It Rain is a likely knockout on Primarina, which is the deciding factor. We easily survive Moonblast even if we move second.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Applying Pokémon battle rules to select a single legal action under output format constraints.Evaluating type matchups and speed uncertainty to pick a legal move within the output format.Evaluating KO certainty and switch risk to confirm Make It Rain over alternatives.

decisions.thought: Opponent is faster but Multiscale is broken and Extreme Speed can't hit Ghost. Make It Rain should knockout the 69% Dragonite before a second Earthquake.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Gholdengo's neutral special attack and Dragonite's broken Multiscale to determine optimal move.Comparing damage calculations and type matchups to assess the KO risk from Earthquake.Evaluating Protect versus attacking now given immunity to Extreme Speed and potential Dragon Dance.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo is slower than Mega Dragonite and Earthquake will knock it out before it can finish the 5% HP Dragonite. Switching out is required to avoid the knockout. Incineroar with Intimidate best survives Earthquake.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing a Pokémon battle speed and priority matchup to determine the optimal move given low HP and a faster opponent.Evaluating Earthquake damage and speed to assess the KO risk before acting.Assessing Protect versus switching to Incineroar or Primarina against the faster opponent.

decisions.thought: Dragonite is at 5% and faster with +1 Speed plus ExtremeSpeed priority. Fake Out has +3 priority so it goes first and should finish the knockout before it moves.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating speed tiers and priority moves to determine the optimal action given HP and stat boosts.Resolving a Fake Out legality conflict on the second turn and switching priority versus moves.
